value.rationale: The exact leakage size and moment frontier quantify whether normal vector-field components create controlled spurious tangent velocities in randomized low-rank evolution. In particular, one-row oversampling has finite mean but infinite variance, while nominal sketch size twice the rank does not make the relative squared leakage vanish with rank. These provide motivated finite-sample error-budget and sketch-size criteria, not merely an algebraic renaming; trajectory-level behavior remains unproved.
